Following our call this morning (notes below). Quick summary: we observed a latency regression during Finova's overnight batch window (approx 02:00–03:30 PT). Root cause is not yet confirmed; provisional mitigations agreed.

Meeting notes (chronological):
- 09:00 — Attendees: Heather Lane (Finova), Tom Jacobs (Finova), Neha (Redwood AE), Marissa (CS), Vivek (Infra Eng)
- Observed impact: 2–3x tail latency increase for text-generation endpoints during batch job bursts; error rates stayed low but UX timeout windows were exceeded.
- Immediate mitigation agreed: temporary routing to a dedicated hot-pool (capacity reservation) for Finova's evaluation traffic. Ops to apply policy at 09:25 PT.
- Technical triage: Vivek to run targeted kv-cache and sequence profiling, check for unexpected memory pressure or kernel path regressions.
- MAP timeline: moved tentative close from 2027-04-20 to 2027-04-26 to allow stabilization and one additional verification week. Finova to confirm whether that extension is acceptable.

Action items (owner — due):
- Marissa Cole — open infra escalation + priority support window (Support ticket #7891) — due 2027-04-12 09:30 PT
- Vivek Kulkarni — initial log triage; provide root-cause hypothesis and temp config steps — due 2027-04-12 15:00 PT
- Neha Kapoor — update Finova exec sponsor with decisions and new MAP close ETA; request approval for timeline extension — due 2027-04-13 EOD
- Heather Lane / Tom Jacobs — confirm acceptance of revised MAP close date 2027-04-26 — due 2027-04-13 EOD

Attachments provided: latency_logs_20270410.zip (engine logs), support_ticket_7891.pdf (ticket export) — uploaded to the shared drive and attached to ticket.

Technical note from Vivek (readout):
> Quick preliminary: cache eviction rates spiked during the batch window, causing repeated key fetches at sequence start. Suspect workload pattern (larger batch sizes + longer sequences) coupled with our default KV cache TTL. I will test a temporary cache TTL increase + capsule routing to dedicated pool and report back.

Thanks — I will confirm when the priority window is in place.

2) Confirm acceptance of the temporary priority support window and routing while we stabilize — we will credit any premium support charges if you decide not to proceed with Redwood at the end of the MAP.

We understand the urgency and have prioritized this internally. If you need an immediate exec bridge, I can loop in our CTO (R&D) but I wanted to check if the current path and timeline are acceptable first.
